This [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] '''species''' originated in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] and had developed a primitive form of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] travel. They were roughly [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] in shape. At some point before [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], a [[Unidentified military commander|military leader]] of this [[Species/Legends|species]] was in conflict with [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] known as [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]].<ref name="Stock Ships">''[[Stock Ships]]''</ref>
